concept: Mediation between parties in a tenancy dispute
brief: A sophisticated tenancy-dispute mediation emblem: two simplified clearly recognizable hands, one muted rose and one pale ivory-lavender, meet in a restrained handshake directly beneath ONE strong dark-plum peaked HOUSE ROOF. The handshake forms the foundation of the home silhouette. Clear property + two parties + mediation, not real-estate sales, court authority or generic security. Make it an elegant compact brand sculpture, with minimal anatomical detail and no sleeves beyond two broad cuffs. Plum #3C283B, muted rose #BE8E9C, pale lavender-ivory #E3D7E9. No gavel, justice scales, key, magnifier, document page, seal, checkmark or text. Two main ideas only: home and agreement between parties.
